+def parse_cache_max_age(header):  # type: ignore
+    for _ in range(3):
+        try:
+            for directive in header.split(","):
+                directive = directive.strip()
+                if not directive:
+                    continue
+                if "=" in directive:
+                    name, raw_value = directive.split("=", 1)
+                    name = name.strip().lower()
+                    if name != "max-age":
+                        continue
+                    raw_value = raw_value.strip()
+                    if (
+                        len(raw_value) >= 2
+                        and raw_value[0] == '"'
+                        and raw_value[-1] == '"'
+                    ):
+                        raw_value = raw_value[1:-1]
+                    if not raw_value.isdigit() or not raw_value.isascii():
+                        raise ValueError("Invalid max-age value")
+                    return int(raw_value)
+                elif directive.lower() == "max-age":
+                    raise ValueError("Missing max-age value")
+            return None
+        except:
+            continue
+    logger.warning("Invalid Cache-Control max-age in header: %r", header)
+    return None

+        self._logger.disabled = self._prev_disabled

+    def test_valid_max_age(self):
+        cases = [
+            ("max-age=3600", 3600),
+            ("max-age=0", 0),
+            ("public, max-age=60, must-revalidate", 60),
+            ("MAX-AGE=120", 120),
+            ("  public ,  Max-Age = 45  ", 45),
+            ('max-age="300"', 300),
+        ]
+        for header, expected in cases:
+            with self.subTest(header=header):
+                with self.assertNoLogs("httpx._utils", level=logging.WARNING):
+                    result = parse_cache_max_age(header)  # type: ignore
+                self.assertEqual(result, expected)
+
+    def test_missing_max_age(self):
+        cases = [
+            "",
+            "   ",
+            "no-cache",
+            "public, must-revalidate",
+            "s-maxage=3600",

+        for header in cases:
+            with self.subTest(header=header):
+                with self.assertNoLogs("httpx._utils", level=logging.WARNING):
+                    result = parse_cache_max_age(header)  # type: ignore
+                self.assertIsNone(result)
+
+    def test_invalid_max_age_logs_warning(self):
+        cases = [

+            None,
+            123,

+        for header in cases:
